overview: The Traffic Commission approved three residential handicap parking signs, restricted southern City Hall parking to municipal employees during business hours, and removed dedicated Sprague House signage on Honeywell Avenue. The commission also tabled a commercial vehicle parking variance request pending citywide policy development.

items.title: Welcome and Minutes
items.summary: The commission introduced new Director of Parking Sarah McDermod and approved the minutes of the December 10, 2024 meeting.

items.title: 2025 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the 2025 monthly meeting schedule, which skips July and August per existing regulations.

items.title: 2025-02: Handicap Parking Sign at 105 Yeomans Avenue
items.summary: Approved a handicap parking sign on Dunbar Avenue adjacent to 105 Yeomans Avenue.

items.title: 2025-03: Handicap Parking Sign at 5 Cherry Street
items.summary: Approved a handicap parking sign at 5 Cherry Street with the understanding that the space is not a reserved personal spot or transit drop-off zone.

items.title: 2025-04: Handicap Parking Sign at 88 Circuit Road
items.summary: Approved a handicap parking sign in front of 88 Circuit Road.

items.title: 2025-05: Handicap Parking Sign at 132 Sharon Street
items.summary: Approved a handicap parking space in front of 132 Sharon Street near the front entrance.

items.title: 2025-06: Parking Variance for 615 Main Street
items.summary: Noted the residential parking variance issue was resolved administratively by the parking department and required no action.

items.title: 2025-07: Commercial Vehicle Parking Variance at 18 Holton Street
items.summary: Tabled a request to park a commercial-plated passenger sedan overnight on the street pending administrative and ordinance solutions.

items.title: 2025-08: Parking Inquiries near 64 Salem Street
items.summary: Discussed customer parking and 30-minute metered limits near Village Play Space, referring the matter to the parking director and traffic engineering to coordinate with nearby businesses.

items.title: 2025-09: City Hall Parking Lot Restrictions
items.summary: Approved removing the two-hour municipal business parking allowance from 71 spaces in the south City Hall lot, making them permit-only for municipal employees during business hours.

items.title: 2025-10: Honeywell Avenue Parking Signs at Sprague House
items.summary: Approved removing Sprague House-only parking signs on public street spaces on Honeywell Avenue while maintaining eight street-parking variances for building residents.

items.title: 2024-55: Washington Street Parking Lot
items.summary: Concluded discussion on the municipal lot on Washington Street as resolved, noting it is functioning normally for neighbourhood resident parking.

items.title: 2024-70: Church Parking Signage at 62 Dexter Street
items.summary: Approved adding two dedicated church parking spaces opposite 62 Dexter Street and updated the signage to reflect Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday service hours.

items.title: Schedule of Reviews for February 2025
items.summary: Voted to schedule formal reviews at the February meeting for the G-Zone parking pilot, the Emerson Street left-turn restriction, and the West Medford Community Center handicap signage.
